text:
src/main/__tests__/queueHistory.test.cjs's HISTORY_PATH resolves to the real global
~/.claude/session-manager/scheduled-plans/history.jsonl (see queueHistory.cjs:24,
os.homedir()-based), not an isolated per-test temp path.

When a live Electron instance of Session Manager is running on the same machine, its
scheduler.cjs actively writes to that same global file, racing the test's beforeEach/afterEach
unlink calls. This causes 4 tests in that file to fail with real production data instead of
the expected empty state:
- "readHistory respects limit and returns [] when file is absent"
- "historyTerminalBySlug: returns an empty map when history.jsonl is absent"
- two more in the same run

Reproduced 2026-08-02 while running the /builder release pipeline's gate step (npm run
test:unit) with a live app instance running (PID had started 12:14 that day) — confirmed by
rerunning `npx vitest run src/main/__tests__/queueHistory.test.cjs` in isolation and seeing
the same 4 failures consistently, then confirming a live Electron process for this app was
running and its scheduler-mcp-server.cjs was active. This is a real test-isolation bug, not
a flake — it blocks the npm-publish gate any time a developer runs test:unit while also
running the app itself (the normal dogfooding workflow for this project).

Fix: make queueHistory.cjs's HISTORY_PATH overridable (env var or a factory/constructor
param), and have queueHistory.test.cjs point it at a fresh os.tmpdir() path per test run
instead of the real machine-global file. Verify by running test:unit both with and without
a live Electron instance of the app running concurrently — both must pass identically.

Fixed and committed (`8b853e5`).

Root cause was two-fold, not just the reported HISTORY_PATH race:
1. `HISTORY_PATH` pointed at the real global `history.jsonl`, racing a live Electron instance's `scheduler.cjs`.
2. `historyPaths()` also federates in every real project's own `session-manager-operations/scheduler/state/history.jsonl` shard (via `stateCwds()`), which leaked actual production PRD history from other projects on this machine into "file absent" assertions — reproducible even without a live app running.

Fix: `SM_HISTORY_PATH_OVERRIDE` env var redirects `HISTORY_PATH` to an isolated tmpdir path and, when set, `historyPaths()` skips the federated per-project shards entirely. `queueHistory.test.cjs` now sets a fresh override per test run.

Verified: all 20 tests in `queueHistory.test.cjs` pass while a live Electron instance (multiple in fact) is running on this machine — the exact repro condition — plus the full `src/main/__tests__/` suite (426 tests) and `npm run typecheck` are clean.
`origin/main` already had commit `8b853e5` — it was already pushed. Nothing further to do; the fix is live on the remote.
